description: This library exports OpenTelemetry span data to Jaeger over gRPC. It lets Java applications send collected traces to a Jaeger endpoint.

skipped-versions.reason: io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-exporter-jaeger:1.34.0 depends on io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-api:1.34.0, whose published jar ships a resource configuration (a 'resources' object) under the name META-INF/native-image/io.opentelemetry/opentelemetry-api/reflect-config.json, so every native-image build fails with 'first level of document must be an array of class descriptors'; fixed upstream in 1.34.1, where opentelemetry-api renames the file to resource-config.json.

description: This library exports OpenTelemetry span data to Jaeger over gRPC. It lets Java applications send collected traces to a Jaeger endpoint and supports Java 8+ and Android API level 24+.
